prompt: The cluster license has expired and an operator follows this runbook. Which line is wrong?
explanation: An expired license blocks database changes and the creation of new databases, so line 3 cannot succeed until a valid license is applied. Everything else in the runbook stays legal while expired: you can still sign in and view settings and metrics, change cluster settings — including uploading the new license key — and the cluster keeps serving existing databases.
codeLines: 2. Update the key under Cluster > Configuration > General > License
3. While the license is expired, add a replacement database to absorb failover shards
4. Save the new key and confirm cluster status looks healthy again
